drawing.hint.blackPoint: Everything darker than this counts as pure black. Raise it (e.g. 20–40) to drop a dirty grey background; keep 0 for clean images.
drawing.hint.whitePoint: Everything brighter than this counts as pure white (not drawn). Lower it (e.g. 220–240) to drop a greyish or tinted paper background.
drawing.hint.gamma: Adjusts midtone brightness. Above 1: brighter, fewer dark strokes. Below 1: darker, more strokes. Usually 0.8–1.3.
drawing.hint.maxSide: Long side of the image while processing. Empty: computed from the drawing box and pen (box ÷ pen × 1.3). Lower for faster runs on weak machines, higher to keep fine detail. Max 4000.
drawing.hint.clahe: Brings out detail in locally too-dark or too-bright areas. Good for backlit photos; may amplify noise.
drawing.hint.denoise: Removes grain while keeping edges. Slow (seconds on weak machines); enable only for dim photos.
drawing.hint.kind: Zigzag: parallel hatching joined into one stroke, few pen lifts. Wave: one wavy line per row, darker means denser waves. Spiral: the whole picture is one stroke. Outline: lines only, good for drawings and logos.
drawing.hint.paletteMode: Single color: one pen, one G-code file. Multi-color: splits into 2–4 colors, one G-code file each, and you swap pens while drawing.
drawing.hint.paletteColors: Number of colors to split into (2–4), only used in Multi-color. Fewer colors are faster and need fewer pen swaps.
drawing.hint.levels: Number of tone levels. More levels give smoother shading but more strokes (3 = coarse, 5 = fine).
drawing.hint.angle: Hatch direction: 0° horizontal, 90° vertical, 45° diagonal. With several colors, give each a different angle.
drawing.hint.spacing: Distance between two hatch lines in the lightest area. Do not go below the pen width (0.2 or 0.4 mm) or lines overlap. Empty: automatic.
drawing.hint.amplitude: Wave style only: wave height. Larger than the hatch spacing and neighbouring waves touch. Empty: automatic.
drawing.hint.outlineOverlay: Draws a sketch outline on top of the shading to keep the composition clear (good for portraits and landscapes).
drawing.hint.invert: Swaps light and dark: enable for a dark background with a light subject.
drawing.hint.simplify: Drops redundant points on strokes (mm). Larger: lighter file, faster, but less smooth. Pen 0.2 should stay ≤ 0.05; pen 0.4 can use 0.1.
drawing.hint.merge: Joins two strokes whose end and start are closer than this (mm): fewer pen lifts. Too large joins unrelated strokes.
drawing.hint.minPath: Drops strokes shorter than this (mm) to filter specks. Too large loses small details.
drawing.hint.passes: Number of 2-opt passes optimizing drawing order. 50 is enough; more barely shortens the travel.
drawing.hint.order: Orders the strokes so the pen travels less without drawing between them.
drawing.hint.twoOpt: Careful ordering, about 25% less travel but slower; switches off automatically above 15,000 strokes.
